project.name: MCP Server - Spring Boot MCP tools provider
project.description:
Standalone Spring Boot application that exposes tools via MCP protocol over Streamable HTTP (POST /mcp, Spring AI 2.0 default). Both the LangChain4j and the Spring AI agent connect to it as an external tool provider.
Tools exposed (all wrapped by McpToolTelemetry from `common`: SERVER span "mcp_tool NAME" + mcp.tool.* meters): - get_game_stats : fetch game statistics - get_weather : mock weather tool (demo) - search_notes : search notes in the knowledge base - save_note : save a note - requires human approval - delete_note : delete a note - requires human approval
Port: 8081
Spring AI 2.0 notes: - Tools are @McpTool methods discovered by the annotation scanner; @Tool + MethodToolCallbackProvider is the AGENT-side API now. - Use spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webmvc; the low-level mcp-spring-webmvc and the MCP SDK version come transitively from the Spring AI BOM. Do NOT declare mcp-spring-webmvc or mcp-bom. - protocol: STREAMABLE (application.yml); SSE is deprecated for removal in 2.0 and is not served.
